heroHeadline: US Refuses to Join Saudi Ground Offensive Against Houthis, Exposing Coalition Gap
heroSubtitle: Washington confirmed it will not participate in Saudi Arabia's planned ground assault to retake Bab el-Mandeb 'for now', as Riyadh readies roughly 100,000 Yemeni troops for a major offensive. The US position reveals a key limit within the Mecca Pact coalition even as American air defense support continues.
